title: SharpXR: Structure-Aware Denoising for Pediatric Chest X-Rays
summary: Proposed a structure-aware dual-decoder U-Net (SharpXR) that combines a Laplacian-guided edge-preserving decoder with a learnable fusion module. The model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in denoising low-dose pediatric X-rays while preserving diagnostically relevant features, improving downstream pneumonia classification accuracy from 88.8% to 92.5%.

title: Cross-Modality Attention Fusion for Chest X-ray Diagnosis
summary: Investigating whether fusing features from chest X-ray images and corresponding textual radiology reports can improve diagnostic accuracy. Designing a cross-attention transformer model to learn joint representations of visual and textual data, exploring its effectiveness in identifying subtle pathologies missed by image-only models.

title: VAMAE: Vessel-Aware Masked Autoencoders for OCT-Angiography
summary: Developing a self-supervised pre-training method for OCT-A image analysis. Proposing a masked autoencoder (MAE) variant with a vessel-aware loss function that prioritizes the reconstruction of fine vascular structures to improve vessel segmentation and disease classification with limited labeled data.
